263823: Considered one of the school's most beautiful girls, Shirakawa is easygoing and friendly with most people, earning her even more popularity.
263824: Kashima has admired Shirakawa since the first year and got the lucky break of moving to the same class as her during the second year, turning simple admiration into a one-sided crush. Kashima never hoped to get more than that and was happy with keeping the status quo.
